This mission has health scaling, meaning that in duos, enemy health is increased by around 20%, in trio 40% and in quad 60%. ==Rewards== '''Burning Bridges''' has a {{Coins|240}} and {{Exp|35}} reward upon first triumph. Any subsequent triumphs will reward {{Coins|80}} and {{Exp|35}} instead. Losing on any wave will only reward {{Exp|0}}. Additionally, the mode can also give out a bonus triumph reward.
